With the game running that page rendered EMPTY both times (only the status bar and the A / B hints, the page had 99 nodes, no focusable element, the screenshot did not change for 30 s, game fell to 2 FPS while it was up). B returned to the game cleanly both times. I could not read a reload control on it.

(With no game running that page may show more; not tested, outside the runbook.) The only way to reload found was the rig's loader restart.
